title: 第7章 给我肉如何快速升级指南第8章 技能与要求
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
艾可的心跳加速，她的小身体在空中划过一道弧线，仿佛一颗即将坠落的流星。那些守卫们自信满满，以为已经掌握了全局，准备以迅雷不及掩耳之势将她拦截。然而，就在她即将触及卡片的一刹那，她用尾巴巧妙地一抽，改变了方向，让他们措手不及。
她的脸朝下猛地扑在了正确的卡片上，但强大的惯性让她和卡片一起滑向了查尔。查尔呆呆地看着她，只见她捂着鼻子，因为那猛烈的撞击，鼻子都有点歪了。
-10点生命值
艾可对这个突然弹出的提示嗤之以鼻，她还有18点生命值，这让她暗自庆幸自己的幸运。她的最大生命值是80点，但新手保护已经失效，她只能依靠[生命值恢复]慢慢地恢复。这个过程漫长而艰辛，恐怕得花上好几天的时间……
巴迪看到朋友那副像是吃了苦药一般难看的表情，忍不住哈哈大笑起来。他心里清楚得很，查尔让他的儿子们这样做，可他却没有加以干涉。巴迪深知尊严对于一个统治者来说是何等的重要，然而这个小家伙为了几块肉，毫不留情地打了他的脸，而且还不止一次。
他大方地把剩下的肉都给了她，艾可满心困惑，就在这时，一个声音在她的脑海中响起。（“最好到此为止。我朋友需要些时间恢复。”）他咯咯地笑着。
艾可乖巧地点点头，满心欢喜地吃了起来。
[等级：20（第一次进化）]
[您可以进化为[普通]动物]
艾可眯起眼睛，仔细地看着上面的提示。上面说的是动物，这意味着他无法在兽类等级中更进一步，但紧接着。
[进一步升级将允许您进化为[不常见]动物兽类。]
兽类！也许不是什么超级酷的兽类，但他能够进化为兽类！这才是至关重要的关键所在。
他开心地吃着，等级如同火箭般不断飙升，但不知为何，他面前的肉却仿佛永远也吃不完，丝毫没有减少的迹象？
艾可困惑地环顾四周，那些野兽却都纷纷避开了她的目光。她实在是不明白这究竟是为什么……她根本不知道自己的“颜值”已经达到了210，这已经是一个相当高的数值了，这也是她的肉永远吃不完的神秘原因……
[等级：34（第一次进化）]
艾可始终没有收到关于[不常见]进化的提示，似乎他还需要更多的肉才能实现这一目标，但……
他的整个身体就像一个鼓鼓的大气球，因为吃了太多太多的肉。这场景实在是滑稽极了，因为他吃得太多，以至于行动都变得异常困难。
*嗝*
他觉得自己的肚子饱得快要炸开了，一心只想找个地方躲起来好好消化消化，但是……
艾可突然被查尔的女儿抱了起来，她的眼睛里闪烁着兴奋的光芒。她抱着艾可欢快地回到座位上，让艾可依偎在她那柔软如云朵的腿上，尽情享受着那温暖而舒适的触感。

艾可瞬间僵住了，一动也不敢动，但很快就幸福地打起了盹儿……
……
女仆瞪大了眼睛，恶狠狠地瞪着查尔的女儿，撅着嘴，满脸的不高兴。她也渴望能够抱抱这只可爱得让人无法抗拒的小狐狸！查尔注意到女仆和他女儿之间那小小的“争斗”，无奈地摇了摇头。然而，两人都不敢有任何动作，生怕一不小心就吵醒了熟睡中的她。
……
艾可又悠悠转醒，可还没等她惬意地伸个懒腰，就闻到了一股美味的肉香，她想都没想，立刻就咬了上去。这肉的口感很是奇怪，有点硬邦邦的……硬得完全不合她的口味。
她迷迷糊糊地睁开眼睛，却瞬间呆住了。她的嘴里竟然是一只长满鳞片的手。她不太清楚这究竟是谁的手，但她心里明白，不管这是谁的手，情况都不太妙。
她的耳朵瞬间耷拉了下来，然后又假装睡着了。
“你不饿吗？”女仆轻声逗着她。“这儿有美味的食物哦。”看到小狐狸的耳朵动了动，女仆的眼睛里顿时闪烁着兴奋的光芒。
“啊，也许我应该给兄——”她的话还没说完，艾可就像一支离弦的箭一样扑向了肉，可惜没扑到，却咬住了盘子，整个身子就这样悬在了半空中。
女仆一时间愣住了，她下意识地捏了捏鼻子。感觉好像有股热流涌出，似乎是流鼻血了，但那肯定只是艾可的想象……
她小心翼翼地把艾可放了下来，艾可又开始尽情地大快朵颐起来。
[等级：40（第一次进化）]
[您可以进化为[不常见]动物兽类]
content_en:
Aike's heartbeat accelerated, and her little body drew an arc in the air, like a meteor about to fall. The guards were full of confidence, thinking they had the overall situation under control, and were ready to intercept her with lightning speed. However, just as she was about to touch the card, she changed direction with a clever twitch of her tail, catching them off guard.
She flung herself face down onto the correct card, but the force of inertia caused her and the card to slide towards Char. Char looked at her blankly, and saw that she was covering her nose, which was a little crooked due to the violent impact.
-10 health points
Ai Ke scoffed at this sudden pop-up prompt. She still had 18 health points, which made her secretly grateful for her luck. Her maximum health is 80 points, but the novice protection has expired, and she can only rely on [Health Recovery] to slowly recover. This process is long and arduous and may take several days...
Buddy couldn't help laughing when he saw his friend's ugly expression, as if he had taken bitter medicine. He knew very well that Charles had asked his sons to do this, but he did not interfere. Buddy knew how important dignity was to a ruler, but this little guy slapped him in the face mercilessly, more than once, for a few pieces of meat.
He generously gave her the rest of the meat, and Aiko was confused. At this moment, a voice sounded in her mind. ("Better stop there. My friend needs some time to recover.") He chuckled.
Ai Ke nodded obediently and started eating happily.
[Level: 20 (first evolution)]
[You can evolve into [normal] animals]
Aike narrowed his eyes and read the prompts above carefully. It says animal, which means he can't go any further in the beastly hierarchy, but then.
[Further upgrades will allow you to evolve into [uncommon] animal beasts. ]
Beast! Maybe not a super cool beast, but he can evolve into one! This is the crucial key.
He ate happily, and his level continued to soar like a rocket, but for some reason, the meat in front of him seemed to be endless and showed no signs of decreasing?
Echo looked around in confusion, but the beasts all avoided her gaze. She really doesn't understand why... She has no idea that her "appearance" has reached 210, which is already a very high value. This is also the mysterious reason why she can never finish eating...
[Level: 34 (first evolution)]
Echo never received a hint about the [uncommon] evolution, and it seems like he needs more meat to achieve that goal, but...
His whole body was like a big bulging balloon from eating too much meat. This scene is really funny, because he eats so much that it becomes extremely difficult to move.
*burp*
He felt that his stomach was so full that he was about to explode, and all he wanted to do was find a place to hide and digest, but...
Aike was suddenly picked up by Char's daughter, her eyes sparkling with excitement. She hugged Aike and happily returned to her seat, letting Aike nestle on her legs as soft as clouds, enjoying the warm and comfortable touch.
Ai Ke froze for a moment, not daring to move, but soon he happily dozed off...
…
The maid's eyes widened and she glared at Charles' daughter fiercely, pouting with an unhappy look on her face. She also longs to cuddle this irresistibly cute little fox! Charles noticed the little "fight" between the maid and his daughter and shook his head helplessly. However, neither of them dared to make any move for fear of accidentally waking her up while she was sleeping.
…
Ai Ke woke up slowly again, but before she could feel comfortableShe stretched out happily and smelled the delicious aroma of meat. She immediately bit into it without even thinking about it. The texture of this meat was very strange, a bit hard... so hard that it was not to her taste at all.
She opened her eyes drowsily, but was stunned for a moment. In her mouth was a scaly hand. She wasn't sure whose hand it was, but she knew in her heart that no matter whose hand it was, the situation was not good.
Her ears drooped for a moment, and then she pretended to be asleep again.
"Aren't you hungry?" the maid teased her softly. "There is delicious food here." Seeing the little fox's ears move, the maid's eyes suddenly shone with excitement.
"Ah, maybe I should give it to my brother--" Before she could finish her words, Ai Ke rushed towards the meat like an arrow from the string. Unfortunately, he didn't hit it, but bit the plate, and his whole body was suspended in mid-air.
The maid was stunned for a moment, and she pinched her nose subconsciously. It felt like there was a stream of heat gushing out, and it seemed like a nosebleed, but that was definitely just Aike's imagination...
She carefully put Aike down, and Aike began to eat to his heart's content.
[Level: 40 (first evolution)]
[You can evolve into [uncommon] animal beasts]
